BridgeToolActivityStatus.description: Lifecycle of one tool call executing inside a bridged external agent core.

oneOf.description: The core scheduled the call; `detail` summarizes the input.
The call finished successfully; `detail` carries an output preview.
The call failed; `detail` carries the error message.

description: Live status of one tool call executing inside a bridged external agent core (the ZCode warm bridge). Display only: the tool ran on the far side of the bridge, so it has no matching item in the thread history.

callId.description: The external core's id for the tool call.

detail.description: Bounded human-readable detail (input summary, output preview, or error message), capped by the bridge before emission.

title: BridgeToolActivityNotification
